state.purpose: Adversarial bug triage. Inspect supplied source for concrete failures, independent of previous green suites. Tests will adjudicate.

http_renamed_fields_can_swap.instructions: If a request constructor takes A then B but JSON metadata lists B then A, and a resolver renames both, can fallback by constructor index bind A from B and B from A?

cross_scheme_same_host_accepted.instructions: Can an HTTPS request with Origin:http://same-host be treated as same-origin when Sec-Fetch-Site is absent and no CORS policy permits it, because MatchesHost compares host/default ports without request.Scheme?

cross_origin_gate_has_scheme_data.instructions: Is the request scheme available to the supplied cross-origin gate even though MatchesHost does not receive it?

nul_separators_alias_checkpoint_identity.instructions: Can resource=order\0part and rebuild=v2 collide with resource=order and rebuild=part\0v2 in a NUL-separated checkpoint key when those embedded NUL characters are accepted by the identity validators?

identity_validators_reject_nul.instructions: Do the supplied stream-pattern and checkpoint-generation validators reject embedded NUL characters before key encoding?
